name: Grid Icons
description: Drawn on a strict 24px grid at a single stroke weight, so they sit together without anyone having to nudge anything. SVG and a variable icon font, plus the Figma file the set was drawn in.

name: Field Notes
blurb: A colour grade for photographs taken in bad light.
description: Twelve presets built for overcast afternoons and indoor light that nobody chose. Lightroom and Capture One profiles, and a plain LUT for everything else.

name: Monaco Mono
blurb: A monospace family with a real italic.
description: Five weights with matching italics that were drawn rather than slanted. Ligatures are there and can be switched off. Includes web fonts and a desktop licence for one person.

name: Shipping Notes
blurb: A short book about releasing software people already use.
description: About a hundred pages on migrations, deprecations, and telling users bad news early. EPUB and PDF, no DRM, updates included.
